label: 1x32 PLC splitter, SC/APC, pre-connectorised
description: 1x32 balanced planar-lightwave-circuit splitter with SC/APC connectors on the input and all thirty-two output legs, 1260-1600 nm. Insertion loss <=17.2 dB (pre-connectorised), uniformity <=1.5 dB, PDL <=0.40 dB, return loss >=55 dB. Unpowered, and every frame leaves on all other legs.
notes: Prysmian AC005 issue 06, pre-connectorised table: 1x32 insertion loss <=17.2 dB, uniformity <=1.5, PDL <=0.40, RL >=55 dB, 1260-1600 nm, pigtails 1.5 m, 7 x 4 x 60 mm package. XSPSG00010 is the SC/APC variant; unconnectorised is XSPSG00005 at <=16.7 dB. The simulator charges 17.5 dB for a 1:32 (its worst-case figure), so it is 0.3 dB more pessimistic than this part - the safe direction for a reach plan.
